class.name: CubismSpeechHandle
class.brief_description: Retained terminal result for a character cue.
class.description: Owns only status, error and elapsed time; no model pointers. Check is_finished before awaiting finished, including immediately rejected cues. A terminal reason never changes. Completion waits for both voice and assigned motion. Stop/interruption mark the handle terminal immediately, including when an outgoing fade continues.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Whether a terminal result is available.

method.name: get_reason
method.description: Terminal reason, or NONE during playback.

method.name: get_error
method.description: Error code; OK for successful playback and ordinary cancellation.

method.name: get_elapsed_seconds
method.description: Evaluated cue time excluding negative-offset pre-roll. Retained after completion.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted once, deferred after a running cue becomes terminal. Immediately rejected cues already have a terminal result.

constants.constant: No terminal reason has been assigned.
All active components of the cue completed naturally.
Another cue or a target change interrupted playback.
The character was hidden through its controller.
The target was unloaded or the controller left the scene tree.
The cue was rejected or failed. Inspect [method get_error].
